title: Devin Haney vs Shakur Stevenson
target: Was floated for Nov 28, 2026 in Atlanta at 145 lb; never officially announced
summary: Both sides agreed 145 lb in early October, but talks broke down on Oct 16 over the weight and a rehydration clause. Haney is now officially booked against Liam Paro on Dec 19.

title: Shakur Stevenson vs Raymond Muratalla
target: WBO negotiation deadline Nov 16, 2026, then purse bid; no date set
summary: BoxingInsider reports the WBO has ordered Stevenson, now a free agent after leaving Zuffa Boxing, to negotiate with Raymond Muratalla.
